ValidationRule.description: CRM-8732 Issue Type = Duplicate Case to Skip the required Type and Shipment Field
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISCHANGED( OwnerId )), NOT ( (CONTAINS('System Admin', $User.FirstName) && CONTAINS('Updates', $User.LastName)) || (CONTAINS('Automated', $User.FirstName) && CONTAINS('Process', $User.LastName)) ), CONTAINS(RecordType.DeveloperName,'Qantas_Freight'), OR( AND( NOT( ISNEW()), NOT( ISPICKVAL( Freight_Resolve_Reason__c , 'Duplicate Case')), NOT( ISPICKVAL( Type , 'Invalid Case')), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Freight_Shipment__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT( Type )) ) ), AND( ISNEW(), ISPICKVAL(Origin,'FRT Phone'), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Freight_Shipment__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT( Type )) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter Type, Shipment to proceed
